Scaling Our Feature Store

Background

Section 1 looks at ingestion. Our team measured how ingestion behaved once the pipeline handled billions of rows each day, and we wrote down what broke first, which trade-off we accepted, and how the on-call load changed in the following quarter after rollout number 1.

Section 2 looks at partitioning. Our team measured how partitioning behaved once the pipeline handled billions of rows each day, and we wrote down what broke first, which trade-off we accepted, and how the on-call load changed in the following quarter after rollout number 2.

Section 3 looks at compaction. Our team measured how compaction behaved once the pipeline handled billions of rows each day, and we wrote down what broke first, which trade-off we accepted, and how the on-call load changed in the following quarter after rollout number 3.

Section 4 looks at schema evolution. Our team measured how schema evolution behaved once the pipeline handled billions of rows each day, and we wrote down what broke first, which trade-off we accepted, and how the on-call load changed in the following quarter after rollout number 4.

Section 5 looks at backfills. Our team measured how backfills behaved once the pipeline handled billions of rows each day, and we wrote down what broke first, which trade-off we accepted, and how the on-call load changed in the following quarter after rollout number 5.

Section 6 looks at late events. Our team measured how late events behaved once the pipeline handled billions of rows each day, and we wrote down what broke first, which trade-off we accepted, and how the on-call load changed in the following quarter after rollout number 6.
